description: Rules used when resolving the 'full' preset. The catalog still lists everything; these rules only decide what gets enabled together.

blockedPatterns.reason: Ad blocking circumvents Spotify's monetization and is out of scope for a performance project.
Download and DRM-circumvention tools are not bundled or enabled.

conflictGroups.reason: Multiple lyric providers replace the same view and fight for the same DOM. No preference is set: the most starred provider wins, and Spicy Lyrics is not preferred because it broke the now-playing card on 1.3.6.
Only one extension can own the playback progress bar.
Multiple shuffle replacements hook the same play buttons.
One maintained podcast hider is enough; duplicates only add observers.
Several stats panels render into the same track metadata area.
